newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LOKO HITS FOUR GOALS AS PSG ROUT NICE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LOKO HITS FOUR GOALS AS PSG ROUT NICE.

text.p: France striker Patrice Loko scored four goals as Paris St Germain routed bottom club Nice 5-0 in the French first division on Sunday.
PSG's home win reduced Monaco's lead to nine points with four games left.
It was the second four-goal feat of the weekend after Pascal Nouma of Strasbourg scored all the goals in his side's 4-1 win at Montpellier on Saturday.

Loko, who scored a hat-trick when PSG won 3-0 in the away leg of their European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final tie against AEK Athens six weeks ago, struck in the 39th, 70th, 79th and 88th minutes to take his league tally to 15.

Midfielder Benoit Cauet scored the fourth goal five minutes from time against French Cup finalists Nice whose defeat definitively condemned them to relegation after three seasons in the top flight. They have won only four matches and lost 22.
Loko opened the scoring from a ball by central defender Bruno N'Gotty, a PSG bulwark against Liverpool as they scraped into their second successive Cup Winners' Cup final in midweek.
He added three more in the final 20 minutes, first from a cross by Brazil's Leonardo, then when the ball was laid on by Cauet and added his fourth in the dying minutes.
Monaco were held 1-1 at home by Marseille on Saturday, while Nantes, who also drew 1-1 at home against Caen, had temporarily snatched second place from PSG on goal difference.
PSG, chasing France's second European Cup berth next season, have 60 points to Monaco's 69. Nantes have 57, one more than Strasbourg, who have already qualifed for the UEFA Cup as League Cup winners.
Strasbourg are Monaco's next opponents on Tuesday, while the Parisians are away to Lille, who crashed to their fifth successive defeat 1-0 at Lens on Saturday.
